item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00456","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C11","C17","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C11","confidence":0.72,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C11 plausibly supplied a personnel-assignment letter template: it opens by recalling the recipient's acceptance of a requested assignment, expresses presidential appreciation for undertaking it, praises the qualities brought to the work, and closes with thanks and continuing confidence. C03 parallels appreciation for willingness to continue public service and confidence grounded in prior experience, but concerns elective office rather than a presidential assignment.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"When Secretary Dulles spoke to me of his wish to designate you to represent the United States ... in future disarmament negotiations","parent_excerpt":"When I asked you, last February, to serve temporarily as presiding officer of the Joint Chiefs of Staff","explanation":"Both letters begin by recalling the request or decision that the recipient undertake a specific high-level assignment."},{"child_excerpt":"I want you to know of my appreciation of your willingness to undertake this new and additional task","parent_excerpt":"I want you to know how much I appreciate all that you have done, as well as all that you will do in the future as a consultant and adviser","explanation":"The closely parallel 'I want you to know' formulation expresses appreciation for service extending into a new or continuing role."},{"child_excerpt":"my confidence that you will meet its challenge with the same diligence and ability you always have brought to your assignments","parent_excerpt":"the great effort you have put into the job, and the high regard for your objectivity and impartiality","explanation":"Each grounds confidence in the recipient's established professional qualities and performance."},{"child_excerpt":"you carry with you my cordial best wishes","parent_excerpt":"I want to thank you for a difficult job well done","explanation":"Both conclude the assignment-focused commendation with direct presidential encouragement or thanks."}]}
